meta.name: depmap
meta.description: Query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles. Use for identifying cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validating oncology drug targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询癌症依赖图谱数据，发现肿瘤靶点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在癌症研究中使用DepMap数据筛选基因依赖或药物敏感性。
copy.tagline_en: Query cancer dependency map data to discover tumor targets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze cancer gene dependencies or drug sensitivity data from DepMap.

howto.what: 查询癌症依赖图谱（DepMap）数据库，获取CRISPR基因依赖分数、药物敏感性数据和基因效应图谱，帮助识别癌症特异性脆弱性和合成致死相互作用。
howto.when: 当询问某个基因在特定癌症细胞系中的生存必需性、查找合成致死基因对或分析药物敏感性的生物标志物时触发。

say.text: 查一下KRAS基因在肺癌细胞系中的依赖分数。
say.note: 返回各细胞系的Chronos分数列表。

say.text: 找BRCA1突变细胞系中哪些基因是合成致死伙伴。
say.note: 比较突变与野生型细胞系的基因效应。

say.text: 分析EGFR抑制剂在EGFR突变细胞系中的敏感性。
say.note: 关联基因突变与药物响应数据。

howto.what_en: Query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for CRISPR gene dependency scores, drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles to identify cancer-specific vulnerabilities and synthetic lethal interactions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked about gene essentiality in a specific cancer cell line, synthetic lethality, or biomarkers for drug sensitivity.

say_en.text: Check the dependency score of KRAS in lung cancer cell lines.
say_en.note: Returns Chronos scores per cell line.

say_en.text: Find synthetic lethal partners for BRCA1-mutant lines.
say_en.note: Compares gene effects between mutant and WT.

say_en.text: Analyze sensitivity of EGFR inhibitors in EGFR-mutant lines.
say_en.note: Correlates mutation with drug response data.
